qAndA.answer: The kids struggle with overcoming their fear of loping (horseback riding at a faster gait) and getting their horses in the correct leads.

qAndA.answer: Nicole focuses on building their confidence and control while riding. By Friday, she hopes that the beginner kids will feel comfortable loping around the arena, and the intermediate and advanced kids will be able to guide their horses into the correct leads and lope with confidence and control.
